consumption_module_declaration.compiles_to: the audio2tool direct layer = configs/baseline/a2t-native-system-direct-v1.json policy blocks
consumption_module_declaration.why_not_native_episode: A direct program carries no native_episode block (the native-episode loader refuses one on any program that is not the native-role episode), so the declaration lives here and is proven by the byte proof rather than verified by the loader.

failure_policy: Stop and preserve on the first failure. No automatic restart, replay, row filtering, roster, prompt, knowledge, geometry or cap change. A failure in the smoke stops the chain and pass A does not open; a failure in pass A stops the chain and pass B does not open. AT MOST ONE root-diagnosed recovery re-registration per run id, which needs BOTH a new generation attempt id AND a new live_phase_fit run and attempt id (a journaled fit cannot be retried under a spent fit identity); a second failure closes the cell and the fix is proven on a four-row dry run. RESUME-RECOVERY CLAUSE (owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18): an INFRASTRUCTURE abort with code and request bytes unchanged takes the resume-recovery form of harness item E10 -- the same run id, a fresh attempt id, a resume_from declaration naming the predecessor attempt and its trace SHA-256, every COMPLETE row kept without selection under invariant I7r, every partial or unstarted row re-flown in full, no change to the roster, comparator, decision rule or caps, and the run-cumulative budget re-checked; otherwise the one recovery is a full re-fly under fresh identities. A partial manifest is never scored and never read. If pass A and pass B do not seal on ONE resident session, the pair is not request-identical and the null is not read from it.

generation_budget.definition: The direct-only phase program makes exactly one contact per row: 400 x 1 = 400; the live phase fit makes 1 + (2 + 1) x 400 = 1201 tokenizer endpoint calls under SAEA-A2T-NATIVE-STAGE3-MODULE-ALLOFF-FIT-V1. Ceilings, not targets; run-cumulative across attempts.

purpose: the evidence-consumption module's ALL-OFF arm on audio2tool: every component off, which compiles to the carrier's DIRECT layer. Audio2Tool has no locked system (base lock v3 section 4; the harness receipt names no Audio2Tool default plan), so the module's all-off arm is the DIRECT baseline of the shared controller -- a2t-native-system-direct-v1's policy blocks (phase-direct-only-v1 and its one phase_material.direct entry), byte-identical to the sealed direct a2t-native-role-direct-union4000-v1 and to both A2T-AA passes. It is the carrier admission gate of design section 2b.3: the module-bare arm on the carrier's own roster before any component is turned on there. Own null: h_A2T 1.625 pp official tool accuracy, 1.375 pp official exact match, parameter-F1 margin 2.23 (owner decision 167, docs/results/2026-09-27-a2t-aa-paired-400-read.md), measured on THESE request bytes: the all-off arm is request-identical to A2T-AA pass A and pass B, so its module null is that null by construction, and the carrier admission gate (design 2b.3) is met by the byte proof without a new flight. A FORM proof: it claims no benefit, admits nothing and compares no mechanism; no component-on cell exists for this carrier. Development numbers only (owner decisions 28 and 86).

stage3_algorithm.note: This cell carries NO training-free RL operator and says so explicitly: it is the evidence-consumption module with every component off on a carrier with no locked system -- the carrier's direct baseline expressed as a module block, the carrier admission gate of the consumption-module design (section 2b.3).
